manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Searches the user's inbox for newsletters, digests, and industry publications from the past 7 days and returns an article-style weekly brief in four sections plus a deep-research companion on the top stories.
manifest.display_name: Turn inbox noise into a curated intelligence brief
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/turn_inbox_noise_into_an_intelligence_brief

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

company_name.description: The company whose internal newsletters get their own section of the brief.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

delivery_schedule.description: When to send the brief; the recipe defaults to every Friday afternoon.

exclusions.description: Personal or consumer newsletters to leave out, e.g. hardware deals or fundraising mail.

industry.description: The user's industry, used as the fourth section of the brief.

lookback_days.description: How far back to search the inbox for newsletters; the recipe defaults to the past 7 days.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.
